verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a machine-payments flow that supports stablecoin payments over the x402 protocol, with a 0.01 USDC minimum. That is an agent-oriented payment rail, but it appears to sit on the accepting side rather than letting an agent initiate payments or payouts. Stablecoin payouts and Treasury stablecoin sending exist, but nothing ties them to agent-initiated flows under human-configured authority. Missing for 10: documented agent-initiated stablecoin payment or payout flows, human-configured spend controls or scoped authority for agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
